routes.notes: sets a signed cookie on success
admin-only endpoints; require signed cookie identifying an admin user

observations: The application is implemented entirely as MySQL stored procedures.
Templates are stored in a templates table and rendered via a template_string procedure that performs simple ${var} substitution.
Cookies are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using a server-side signing_key value stored in the config table.
POST parameters are checked against a blocklist that rejects values containing the literal string 'signing_key'.
